name: List Files in Folder
description: Retrieves a list of the files and/or folders directly within a folder. [See the documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/onedrive/developer/rest-api/api/driveitem_list_children)

configurable_props.name: driveId
configurable_props.label: Drive ID
configurable_props.description: Identifier of a drive within a site

configurable_props.name: folderId
configurable_props.label: Folder ID
configurable_props.description: The folder to list files in. You can either search for the folder here or provide a custom *Folder ID*.

configurable_props.name: excludeFolders
configurable_props.label: Exclude Folders?
configurable_props.description: Set to `true` to return only files in the response. Defaults to `false`

configurable_props.name: select
configurable_props.label: Select
configurable_props.description: A comma-separated list of properties to return in the response

configurable_props.name: orderBy
configurable_props.label: Order By
configurable_props.description: The field to order the results by
